findings.title: File inclusion (LFI/RFI): untrusted input reaches include()
findings.message: Intra-file candidate: http input at vuln.php:2 may reach the include sink include() at vuln.php:3 through 1 hop(s). Tainted data selects a file to include — and an included file is executed. Map the input through an allow-list of known includes (a switch/array lookup), never build the path from it; disable allow_url_include. Heuristic — verify the data actually reaches the sink unsanitized before trusting it.
